name: context-mode
description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
one_liner: Shrinks the amount of text an AI coding agent has to re-read each time, so it stays fast and focused even on huge projects.
buyer: A platform engineer at a large company (the README cites usage at firms like Microsoft and Google) standardizing AI coding tools across many teams.
business_use_cases: A large engineering org deploys it to keep AI agent costs and latency manageable across thousands of daily sessions.
A platform team uses the session-memory feature to maintain long-running AI agent projects without context loss.
A dev tooling vendor licenses the underlying approach into their own enterprise AI coding product.

money_ideas.idea: Offer an enterprise support/licensing tier on top of the open-source core (its license already signals this direction).
Sell rollout and tuning consulting to large orgs standardizing on it.

steal_this: This weekend, write a case-study style comparison showing token/cost savings at scale, and use it to pitch a paid rollout engagement to a mid-size engineering org.
